name: dark_sizzle
description: The 'Mayya' sizzle look: dark high-contrast grade, one-word-pop captions, fast cuts, riser/whoosh SFX, and zoom transitions. High energy, made to stop the scroll. Maximalist motion.

grade.notes: warm_cinematic = +12% contrast, crushed blacks, -12% sat, warm shadows / cool highs, filmic curve. The closest built-in to a moody, cinematic, high-contrast sizzle grade.

captions.notes: ONE big word at a time, pop-scale in, keywords + numbers tinted to the brand accent. Drives the relentless pace.

punch_in.notes: Snappy 14% punch on nearly every cut — a hard, fast push that adds kinetic energy.

pacing.notes: Fast. Cut on the beat, change the frame constantly, never let a shot sit.

transition.notes: Zoom-in blend on a meaningful share of cuts (still let ~60% stay hard). Pairs with a riser SFX. Occasional whip_pan for direction changes.

sfx.notes: Riser leads into a punch cut, whoosh on whip-pans, impact lands on the hardest hits. This is the signature of the look — lean in.

notes: The high-energy, dark, fast-cut sizzle reel (the Mayya aesthetic). Everything is turned up: grade, pace, SFX, transitions. Best for hype/launch/announcement content, NOT for calm storytelling.
